messages:
sarah: Morning — heads up, seeing a ~30% drop in MQLs attributed to paid social this week on the weekly KPI board: https://redwood.app/dashboards/marketing/lead-attrib?range=7d :eyes:
mike: on it, pulling raw events now
mike: quick scan — our pipeline agg is using last_touch with a 7d window, but the marketing report snapshot uses 30d. could be the mismatch
jordan: hmm that rings a bell, there was a config tweak in ETL last night
ops-bot: Deploy 2024-04-15T02:12:20Z: pipeline/config update by infra-deploy (change: default_attrib_window=7d)
mike: here's the query I'm running to validate: ```SELECT utm_source, utm_medium, COUNT(DISTINCT lead_id) AS leads FROM events WHERE event='lead' AND event_ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY utm_source, utm_medium;```
anya: two things: window discrepancy and UTMs. I see a lot of `utm_medium=cpc` and `utm_medium=paid_social` both used for the same channel — we'll undercount if normalization missing
sarah: ok. preference: standardize ETL to 30d since that's what stakeholders expect for weekly KPIs, or change dashboard default to 7d?
jordan: pragmatic: revert ETL to 30d (so downstream is consistent), but also add a dashboard selector and default to 30d. ETL revert needs infra sign-off though
mike: I can patch dashboard default & tooltip today (low risk). ETL change needs a staging revert + review. tagging @eng-oncall for the revert
eng-oncall: saw the deploy, it was unintended. we'll revert to previous param in staging and run smoke tests. prod revert needs change approval from infra owners
anya: I'll open a PR with ETL param set to 30d and add normalization step for utm_medium (map cpc, paid_social, paid-social -> paid_social). linking tests
sarah: great. action items: 1) revert ETL in staging (eng-oncall) 2) PR from anya to prod for ETL + UTMs 3) dashboard default -> 30d (mike) 4) update KPI doc to show both 7d & 30d columns for clarity next week
mike: done — dashboard default set to 30d and added tooltip: "Reporting defaults to 30d last-touch unless otherwise selected. See MKT-412." Link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/marketing/lead-attrib?default=30d
sarah: thanks, I'll update weekly KPI deck and ping Demand and Rev Ops stakeholders
jordan: ticket created: MKT-412 — "ETL attribution window drift + UTM normalization" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MKT-412 (assigned to anya)
anya: assigned and started tests. will follow up in the ticket with expected ETA
sarah: awesome, thanks team :white_check_mark:
